name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.GGH15.encode_path_identity
title: Honest GGH15 evaluation on the support of Construction 5.1 (exact identity mod q)
statement: For every output (A_0..A_h, D) of the GGH15 encoding encode p S A_h (CVW18 Construction 5.1 with ideal trapdoor sampling), A_h is the given top matrix and there are errors E such that, for every path x, exactly over Z_q: A_0 D_x = S_x A_h + sum_j (S_{x_0}...S_{x_{j-1}}) E_{j,x_j} (D_{x_{j+1}}...D_{x_{h-1}}).
